newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 22.125 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 22.125 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate (TIIE) rose to 22.125 percent on Wednesday from 21.305 percent on Tuesday, the Mexican Stock Exchange said.
The 91-day interbank rate rose to 22.365 percent from 21.690 percent on May 28.
The TIIP rate rose to 22.1244 percent on Wednesday from 20.3718 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
